newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pegasus changes name to Pegasus Int'l.
newsitem.headline: Pegasus changes name to Pegasus Int'l.

text.p: Sport shoes maker Pegasus Holdings Ltd said it changed its name to Pegasus International Holdings Ltd with effect from February 5, 1997.

The company said in a statement issued through the stock exchange on Tuesday that the existing share certificates bearing the former company name would continue to be evidence of entitlement to the company's shares and would be valid for trading and settlement purposes. It gave no further details.
Pegasus shares were listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange on October 11, 1996.
